name: Assemblée des représentants du peuple
notes: 161 seats (151 in Tunisia and 10 for Tunisians abroad). Chart by parliamentary bloc as the Assemblée's own page lists them on 2026-11-11 (blocs formed 11 May 2023: Honnêteté et travail 26, La voix de la République 25, Les Libres 23, Pour que le peuple triomphe 18, Nationale indépendante 18, La ligne nationale souveraine 15, and 28 deputies in no bloc). The page counts 153 sitting deputies, so 8 of the 161 seats are shown as vacant (the IPU Parline record has 152 members). Tunisia's parties are weak: a bloc is not a party, so the groups show who sits with whom, not party strength. Bloc names are translated from the Arabic.

name: Conseil national des régions et des districts
notes: Second chamber; its opinion on finance bills is consultative. Seat count from the chamber's own member list (77 names with governorate and region). The chamber has no parliamentary blocs or party groups on its site (its menu lists the bureau, committees and plenary sittings only) and its list shows no party, so the chart has one group.

name: Government of Tunisia
notes: The executive; Minister of Finance Michket Salama Khaldi tabled the 2026 wealth tax.
